description_en: Obtains a Security Token Service (STS) token for assuming a RAM role during OIDC-based role SSO by calling the AssumeRoleWithOIDC operation
description_zh: 进行OIDC角色SSO时，通过调用AssumeRoleWithOIDC接口，获取扮演RAM角色的临时身份凭证（STS Token）
name: AssumeRoleWithOIDC

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the OIDC IdP.

You can view the ARN of the OIDC IdP in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console or by calling an API operation:

RAM console: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327123.html.
API: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327126.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327127.html
parameters.help_zh:
OIDC身份提供商的ARN。

您可以通过RAM控制台或API查看OIDC身份提供商的ARN。具体如下：

RAM控制台：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327123.html。
API：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327126.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327127.html
parameters.name: oidc_provider_arn

parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the RAM role to assume.

You can view the role ARN in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console or by calling an API operation:

Resource Access Management (RAM) console: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html.
API: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要扮演的RAM角色ARN。

您可以通过RAM控制台或API查看角色ARN。具体如下：

RAM控制台：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html。
API：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The OIDC token issued by the external IdP.

Length: 4 to 20,000 characters.

Provide the original OIDC token without Base64 decoding
parameters.help_zh:
由外部IdP签发的OIDC令牌（OIDC Token）。

长度：4~20000个字符。

需要输入原始OIDC Token，无需Base64解码
parameters.name: oidc_token

parameters.help_en:
An additional permission policy attached to the STS token to further restrict its permissions:

If you specify access policy, the final permissions of the STS token are the intersection of the RAM role permissions and access policy.
If you do not specify access policy, the final permissions of the STS token are the permissions of the RAM role.

Length: 1 to 2,048 characters
parameters.help_zh:
为STS Token额外添加的一个权限策略，进一步限制STS Token的权限。具体如下：

如果指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限取RAM角色权限策略与该权限策略的交集。
如果不指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限就是RAM角色的权限。

长度：1~2048个字符
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the token. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 3600. Minimum value: 900. Maximum value: the value specified by `MaxSessionDuration`.

To set the maximum session duration `MaxSessionDuration` for a role, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.help_zh:
Token有效期。单位：秒。

默认值：3600。最小值：900。最大值：`MaxSessionDuration`设置的时间。

关于设置角色最大会话时间`MaxSessionDuration`的具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.name: duration_seconds

parameters.help_en:
The role session name.

This is a user-defined parameter. Set this parameter to the identity of the API caller, such as a username. In ActionTrail logs, you can use different values of RoleSessionName to distinguish actual operators even when the same RAM role is used, enabling user-level access auditing.

Format: The value can contain letters, digits, periods (.), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

Length: 2 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh:
角色会话名称。

该参数为用户自定义参数。通常设置为调用该API的用户身份，例如：用户名。在操作审计日志中，即使是同一个RAM角色执行的操作，也可以根据不同的RoleSessionName来区分实际操作者，以实现用户级别的访问审计。

格式：包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、at（@）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。

长度：2~64个字符
parameters.name: role_session_name

AssumedRoleUser.description_en: The temporary identity for role assumption

Arn.description_en: The ARN of the temporary identity

AssumedRoleId.description_en: The ID of the temporary identity

Expiration.description_en: The time when the token expires (UTC)

SecurityToken.description_en:
The security token.
The length of the security token is not fixed. Do not impose any maximum length limit on the security token
SecurityToken.description_zh:
安全令牌。
安全令牌的长度不固定，我们强烈建议您不要对安全令牌的最大长度做任何限制

ClientIds.description_en:
The OIDC audience. Multiple values are separated by commas (,).

This corresponds to the `aud` field in the OIDC token
ClientIds.description_zh:
OIDC受众。多个之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

对应OIDC Token中的`aud`字段值

ExpirationTime.description_en: The expiration time of the OIDC token (UTC)

IssuanceTime.description_en: The issuance time of the OIDC token (UTC)

Issuer.description_en:
The OIDC issuer URL.

This corresponds to the `iss` field in the OIDC token
Issuer.description_zh:
OIDC颁发者URL。

对应OIDC Token中的`iss`字段值

Subject.description_en:
The OIDC subject.

This corresponds to the `sub` field in the OIDC token
Subject.description_zh:
OIDC主体。

对应OIDC Token中的`sub`字段值

VerificationInfo.description_en: The verification information of the OIDC token. For more information, see [Manage an OIDC IdP]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327123.html）
VerificationInfo.description_zh: OIDC Token的检验信息。更多信息，请参见[管理OIDC身份提供商]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327123.html）

SourceIdentity.description_en:
The source identity information.

When assuming a role, you can specify a source identity (SourceIdentity) as the initial identity of the session. The source identity value persists throughout chained role assumption sessions and cannot be changed, ensuring traceability and security of operations.

If no source identity is specified, this field is not returned
SourceIdentity.description_zh:
源身份信息。

在扮演角色时，可以指定扮演者的源身份（SourceIdentity）作为会话的初始身份标识。 该源身份的值在持续扮演角色的链式会话中将一直存在，中途不可更改，可确保操作的可追溯性和安全性。

如果没有设置源身份信息，则该字段不会返回
